senses.gloss: m.(b. h. גִּלָּיוֹן; גלי)blank parchment, margin of scrolls.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 3:4">Yad. III, 4</cite> <he>ג׳ … שמלמעלן וכ׳</he> the blank portions of a sacred book, the upper, the lower margins and those at the beginning and the end; <cite ref="Shabbat 116a:10">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. pl.).

<cite ref="Menachot 30a:15">Men. 30ᵃ</cite>.—Pl. <he>גִּלְיוֹנִין</he>, <cite ref="C00864"><he>גִּילְ׳</he></cite>. Sabb. l. c., v. supra. Ib. <he>הג׳ של ס״ת</he> (Ms. M. sing.) blank parchments of, or intended for, a sacred book.

senses.gloss: (a satirical adaptation of ἐυαγγέλιον, v. אָיֶן) gospel.
units: Tosef. Sabb. XIII (XIV), 5 הג׳ וספרי מינין; Sabb. l. c. הג׳ וספרי הצדוקים (Ms. M. הגליון … מינין) the gospels and books of heretics; [disputants, Sabb. l. c., take our w. in the sense of blanks]. Ib. sq., v. אָוֶן.
Is. III, 23; cmp. גִּלְגְּלִין) a girdle of fine material.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:6">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> (Ar. <he>גליונים</he>; ed. Koh. <he>גולין</he>, corr. acc.).
